handbookNote: Nebraska Revised Statutes Chapter 64 (Notaries Public) -- batch 2 is a depth-expansion pass over the same statute covered by the original 60-question ne_notary track. It drills into sub-clauses and enumerated lists batch 1 left untested (e.g. 64-105.01(3), 64-105.02 signature-by-mark, 64-105.03(2)-(4)/(7)/(8) unauthorized-practice-of-law detail, 64-202(2)/(4), 64-205's non-corporate acknowledgment formulations, 64-206's enumerated short forms, 64-207), adds scenario/fact-pattern variations of already-tested rules (disqualifying relationships, satisfactory-evidence methods, malfeasance/removal, civil liability), and covers whole sections batch 1 did not touch at all: the employer-based acknowledgment carve-outs at 64-211 to 64-215 (attorneys, real estate brokers, banks, credit unions, insurance companies, savings & loan associations), the entirety of Article 3's Electronic Notary Public Act (64-301 to 64-317, in-person notarization with an electronic signature -- distinct from the remote Online Notary Public Act), and several Article 4 (Online Notary Public Act) sections batch 1 omitted (64-409's specific record contents, 64-410(3)-(5), 64-411(3)-(5), 64-412 per-act fee cap, 64-413, 64-414's Class I misdemeanor, 64-416, 64-419, 64-420). Also adds cross-cutting comparison questions among Nebraska's three notary credentials (general, electronic, online). Sections 64-207, 64-211, 64-214, 64-302 through 64-317, 64-412, 64-413, 64-416, 64-419, and 64-420 were fetched fresh from nebraskalegislature.gov/laws/statutes.php on 2026-08-15 for this batch, supplementing the batch 1 research file at temp/handbooks/ne/notary.txt. Price matches this project's established Notary tier ($9.99), unchanged from batch 1.
